Claude Code 2.1.319's documentation, model-config, "Which IDs CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS applies to" (read 7 Nov 2026), the examples quoted:

Claude Code treats an ID as a provider or custom spelling when it doesn't start with `claude-`, in any casing, or when it carries a suffix that Claude Code strips when reading the ID, such as the `@YYYYMMDD` date used on Google Cloud's Agent Platform.

If Claude Code can't resolve a provider or custom spelling to a model it recognizes and the ID contains `[1m]`, in any casing, Claude Code assumes a 1M window for it and the variable doesn't apply on its own.

For example, an ID that contains a Claude model name that Claude Code knows, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-8`, `us.anthropic.claude-…-v1:0`, or the dated `claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929`, resolves to that model.

append `[1m]` to the ID where you set the model, such as `claude --model 'my-gateway-opus[1m]'`
